findings.issue: lit_en does not mirror the JP: それから means 'after that / from that point' (not 'from now on', which would be これから), and 'take off my coins' is invented — ニッケルを取る is 'take the nickel' (single object), not removing worn items. lit_pt renders it correctly; lit_en is garbled.
findings.current: From now on, I'll take off my coins (= take a nickel off), you know.
findings.suggested: After that, (I) take the nickel (object), you know.

findings.issue: 'quanto ao' is a dangling contraction (a + o) with no noun following; the literal-mirror pattern for topic は used elsewhere in the corpus is 'quanto a' (cf. sent:tatoeba-205208 'Aquilo quanto a, caro não-era').
findings.current: Aquilo quanto ao, gradualmente grande tornou-se.
findings.suggested: Aquilo quanto a, gradualmente grande tornou-se.
